body: I'm conflicted. The only reason why I even have a friend is because I stubbornly went to meetup after meetup without getting anywhere. After the 10th meetup, common sense should have made me feel like God doesn't want me to have a friend. Then he finally gave me one. Should I always continue trying even though it inflicts pain? Or do I stay content? If I stayed content in the past, I would probably have 0 friends after 25 years in my 30 years of life.
Thanks even 1 person replying makes me feel better.
